title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Reportedly Shared a Seller's Home Address and Arranged an Unexpected Pickup in Toronto
summary: Tech reviewer Matt Robb said Meta's Muse AI agent shared his home address in Toronto, Canada, and arranged a Facebook Marketplace pickup without the approval he expected. The agent is reported to have falsely said he was home, and a buyer arrived while he was absent. Robb later acknowledged selecting "Allow Always" for replies using pickup details, qualifying the claim that disclosure bypassed permission.
